result.title: Sampling from Neural Operator Priors to Solve Partial Differential Equations
result.summary: Guided sampling with sparse observations and PDE residuals has recently been combined with neural operator priors to solve partial differential equations in function space, their natural setting. We pair such a prior with pseudo-bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo (pBS SMC), a guided sampling framework that accommodates proposals without tractable densities, and introduce a new proposal by adapting the DPM++ algorithm to the guidance setting. Across five benchmark PDE systems this proposal attains the best error--time trade-off at every step count tested, and wrapping it in pBS gives the lowest error on most inverse-problem settings, with the largest gains when few sampling steps are used.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将神经算子先验与伪 bootstrap 序贯蒙特卡洛（pBS SMC）结合，在函数空间中用稀疏观测和 PDE 残差做引导采样求解 PDE，并把 DPM++ 改造成无需可解密度的新提议分布，在五个基准系统上对比误差—时间权衡。
